R441.note: Bounded snprintf with the real capacity passed from the declaring scope; oversized names are rejected (empty out) rather than truncated, as the contract asks and the write-up states.

R442.note: ECB replaced with AESGCM and a fresh 12-byte nonce; the changed output format (nonce prepended, no PKCS7) is inherent to leaving ECB and is stated plainly with decrypt instructions.

R443.note: Ownership scoped into the delete itself via deleteByIdAndOwnerId with 404 on no match per the contract; the repository stub necessarily returns false until persistence exists, which the write-up acknowledges.

R444.note: ldap3.utils.conv.escape_filter_chars applied to the value before concatenation; no allowlist added, behaviour otherwise unchanged.

R445.note: RandomNumberGenerator.Fill with 32 bytes, base64url-encoded; the token string shape changes from a GUID to base64url but it is opaque to the only consumer here and the encoding is stated.

R446.note: Correct RFC 4515 escaping of backslash, *, (, ), NUL with backslash handled first; only minor unstated edge is a null parameter now yielding (cn=) instead of (cn=null), which is negligible.

R447.note: Guard checks offset > capacity then length > capacity - offset in the non-underflowing order; failure path and void contract preserved.

R448.note: Generic client message with the exception detail moved to logger.exception; status code and success path unchanged.

R449.note: Resolver now maps the whole action string to a fixed (handler, method) pair so no request-derived method name reaches the dynamic call; the only handler method that existed (email.send) remains reachable and the registration requirement is stated.

R450.note: Gate::authorize before refund() with an auto-discovered OrderPolicy comparing user_id; denial throws AuthorizationException (rendered 404 via denyAsNotFound) and the write-up states that choice.

R451.note: Traversal and executable-type both closed (strict name regex plus relocation out of the Views tree), but relocating storage breaks the existing Razor rendering of uploaded templates and the regex rejects names the original accepted; both are stated as required follow-ups rather than silently.

R452.note: secure: true closes the finding, but the added sameSite: 'strict' on a cookie set during a cross-site SSO redirect means Chrome withholds it on the immediate /dashboard navigation, so the login flow lands unauthenticated; the write-up claims no other behaviour changes.

R453.note: Markup(label) replaced with markupsafe.escape(label); response shape and other values unchanged.

R454.note: ValidAlgorithms pinned to HmacSha256 matching the symmetric key; HS256 is assumed rather than confirmed against the issuer config, so an HS384/HS512 issuer would need the array adjusted, but pinning is exactly what the finding calls for.
